name: Hungry Tiger 20
author: deepak16375
description: Outlined gray button that reacts on hover with a smooth transition.
howItWorks: On hover, border-radius becomes 4% 95% 6% 95% / 95% 4% 92% 5%, border becomes .2rem dashed #443.
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Hungry Tiger 20</title>
<style>
/* Hungry Tiger 20 by deepak16375 — https://uiverse.io/deepak16375/hungry-tiger-20 */
.button {
  padding: .9rem 1.5rem;
  border: .2rem solid #443;
  border-radius: 95% 4% 97% 5% / 4% 94% 3% 95%;
  color: #443;
  background: none;
  cursor: pointer;
  margin-top: 1rem;
  font-size: 1.7rem;
  transition: all .2s linear;
}

.button:hover {
  border-radius: 4% 95% 6% 95% / 95% 4% 92% 5%;
  border: .2rem dashed #443;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button class="button">
  Button
</button>

</body>
</html>
